data.name: Durvisha
data.gender_notes: Durvisha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Durvisha is derived from the Sanskrit root 'dur' meaning 'difficulty, obstacle, challenge' and the suffix 'visha' meaning 'poison'. In Hindu mythology, Durvasha was the name of a sage who cursed King Janaka, leading to the birth of Sita, the wife of Lord Rama. The name symbolizes the idea of overcoming obstacles with wisdom and courage.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of wisdom and courage to overcome challenges and obstacles.
data.etymology: Durvisha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Difficulty, obstacle, challenge.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Durvisha total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
